initial.prompt: Photorealistic exquisite restaurant menu photograph, elegant restrained fine-dining presentation in warm ivory porcelain bowls, warm natural side light, realistic appetizing fully cooked food textures, quiet beige stone table, tasteful negative space. Chinese yellow catfish and tofu soup: one small fully cooked whole yellow catfish with recognizable broad flat head, fine natural whisker barbels and golden-brown skin partly visible above a light milky fish broth, tender white tofu cubes, a few ginger slices and green scallion bits. Beautiful realistic soup in a broad shallow porcelain bowl. No carp scales, no seafood shellfish, chilies, carrots or noodles.
